jobs.title: Environmental Qualification Test Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 2+ years of experience. B.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or Electrical Engineering 2–5 years of experience in test environments, R&D laboratories, system testing, or integration Hands-on experience designing or executing environmental tests (temperature, vibration, shock, pressure, leak, and/or heat load)

jobs.title: Senior PIC Layout Engineer
jobs.description: B.Sc., M.Sc., or equivalent practical experience in EE, photonics, physics, or a related field Hands-on experience with IC layout and strong proficiency with Virtuoso (or comparable professional layout environments) Familiarity with foundry PDKs, design-rule manuals, GDS workflows, and tape-out preparation
